title: Route Before Response: Fail-Closed Routing for LLM-Enabled Customer-Service Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.07534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-enabled customer-service software in financial institutions must choose a downstream service before responding. Classifiers and LLM routers can identify a relevant label or destination, but a composed application must still verify dispatch permission and entity registration. We study this integration problem as boundary-aware pre-response routing. We present RouteBR, a controller in which one model call proposes a primary service action and registered object, then deterministic code checks identifiers and versioned rules before dispatch or a specified non-dispatch outcome. Lower-ranked candidates cannot replace a blocked primary route. We construct 600 privacy-preserving scenarios from recurring confidential-request patterns at a real financial institution; three engineers jointly reviewed the scenarios and labels. translated_title: 先路由后响应：面向LLM赋能客服软件的故障关闭式路由
translated_abstract: 金融机构中基于LLM的客服软件必须在响应之前选择下游服务。分类器和LLM路由器可以识别相关的标签或目的地，但一个组合式应用仍需验证分发权限与实体注册。我们将这一集成问题作为边界感知的响应前路由进行研究。我们提出了RouteBR，一种控制器：由一次模型调用提出主服务动作和注册对象，随后由确定性代码在分发之前检查标识符和版本化规则，或在指定情形下给出不分发的结果。排名较低的候选者不能替代被拦截的主路由。我们从一家真实金融机构反复出现的机密请求模式中构建了600个隐私保护场景；三名工程师共同审查了这些场景和标签。在200个案例的CONFIRM MAIN分割集上，RouteBR达到了97.5%的最终路径精确匹配。一个匹配的单次调用基线在给定……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: RouteBR提出“先路由后响应”的故障关闭式控制架构，将一次模型调用与确定性代码校验相结合，在真实金融机构的200个场景上实现97.5%最终路径精确匹配，并确保被拦截的主路由不会被低排名候选替代。
en_tdlr: RouteBR introduces a fail-closed pre-response routing controller that combines a single model call with deterministic code checks, achieving 97.5% final-path exact match on real financial-institution scenarios while ensuring blocked primary routes cannot be replaced by lower-ranked candidates.
